input:
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子在那个商店也找了到工作，可是不是做衣服的工作，而是喜欢的工作。孟子学习馆学了十五年，他的学习和他的旅行经验很重要，对他很多好处。他是大人的时候，他成为很有名的哲人。

ITEMS:

[I123] 孟子在那个商店也【找了】到工作   correction: 找了 → 找到了   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 找了 -> 找到了 (corrected 3/5 in train)
  rule card (search_find, Vocabulary): 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person successfully finds <object>, so use 找到, not 找.  Her terms: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 一个人正好[找了→找到了]神农 — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction: 孟母找到一个[打工→打工的工作]
  her past correction: 孟子不是[-在]看商店的员工 — her note: here is not emphasizing “ongoing”

[I124] 可是不是做衣服的工作【，而是喜欢的工作】   correction: ，而是喜欢的工作 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (redundant_words, Other): Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <deleted part> is redundant because <the remaining word(s)> already expresses this meaning.  Her terms: redundant, redundant with是, redundant with看起来
  her past correction: [-和]她也会做她最喜欢的兴趣爱好 — her note: 和cannot connect clauses
  her past correction: 和[-她]也会做她最喜欢的兴趣爱好 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 和她也会做[-她]最喜欢的兴趣爱好 — her note: redundant

[I125] 孟子【^】学习馆学了十五年   correction: ∅ → 在   strength: error
  checker's note: location needs 在 before it
  rule card (laoshi_negative_repetition, Vocabulary): 老是 means “always” and is used for something negative or to complain; for a neutral or positive repeated action, use 一直 or 常常 instead.  Pattern: <老是 + action> → <一直/常常 + action>: the action is neutral or positive, not something negative to complain about, so do not use 老是.  Her terms: 老是
  her past correction: 孟子[+还是]从早到晚努力学习
  her past correction: 孟子从早到晚[+都]努力学习
  her past correction: 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain

[I126] 对他【^】很多好处   correction: ∅ → 有   strength: error
  checker's note: 对他有很多好处 needs 有
  rule card (verb_object_valency, Grammar): Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <verb/verb phrase> must take <the allowed object or complement structure>; <brief reason, such as “it is a V.+Obj. compound” or “the action is durative, so use 着durative”>.  Her terms: 着durative, 跑遍 + place, 管事V.+Obj. compound, 掉 + directional + place, resultative complement
  her past correction: 这些植物对身体[+有]好处
  her past correction: 因为他怕[+有]毒
  her past correction: 他[+的]朋友帮他

[I127] 他【是大人的时候】   correction: 是大人的时候 → 长大后   strength: error
  checker's note: 长大后 is the natural time expression
  rule card (fixed_expressions, Vocabulary): Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use the established expression <correct>, not the literal/nonstandard combination <wrong>.  Her terms: 从 + Place, 制定规定, 自然规律, Subj.算是Obj., 只/不过/才(+num.) + 而已
  her past correction: [是大人的时候→长大以后]
  her past correction: [大人的时候→长大以后]
  her past correction: [长大的时候→长大以后]

[I128] 【他】成为很有名的哲人   correction: 他 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [他成为很有名的老师→哲学家]
  her past correction: [-他]难怪成为了一个很聪明的哲学家
  her past correction: [+后来]他成为一个有名的哲学家 — her note: “他” is ambiguous, 后来成为

[I129] 他成为【^】很有名的哲人   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction: [+后来]他成为一个有名的哲学家 — her note: “他” is ambiguous, 后来成为
  her past correction: 成为很聪明[+的哲学家]

items.explanation: 孟子 successfully finds the job, so use 找到find, not 找look for.
It would be more natural to delete ，而是喜欢的工作. This part is redundant because the sentence already says what kind of job it was not.
Use 在+Place before an action location: 在学习馆学了十五年.
Use 有 in this verb structure: 对他有很多好处.
Use the established expression 长大后, not the literal combination 是大人的时候.
孟子 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete 他; Chinese uses zero form here.
It would be more natural to add 了 because becoming a famous philosopher is a completed change in the story (了completed).
